source_name: New Hampshire Secretary of State — Party Registration History 1970-2026 / Summary of Active Voters (May 4, 2026)
as_of_notes: Official NH SoS 'Summary of Active Voters' as of 4-May-26, downloaded from the Party Registration History 1970-2026 page (XLSX: 2026-05-may-party-registration-history-1970-2026-may-4-2026.xlsx). NH administers registration by town/city; the report lists 243 reporting units (towns, cities, and unincorporated places) each tagged with its county and broken down by Democratic/Republican/Undeclared. NH has no Libertarian registrations in this report. Statewide grand total in the report: DEM 265183, REP 314005, UND 377158, Total 956346 — matches the sum of all 243 units exactly. A 10-county rollup derived from the town-level county tags (all sums verified to the statewide total): Belknap: total 46879 (UND 17561, REP 19318, DEM 10000), Carroll: total 41043 (UND 16612, REP 14632, DEM 9799), Cheshire: total 54092 (UND 22001, REP 15121, DEM 16970), Coos: total 19995 (UND 8108, REP 7256, DEM 4631), Grafton: total 66176 (UND 27559, REP 17292, DEM 21325), Hillsborough: total 270150 (UND 109824, REP 86548, DEM 73778), Merrimack: total 106311 (UND 41162, REP 34686, DEM 30463), Rockingham: total 231891 (UND 86996, REP 83942, DEM 60953), Strafford: total 90627 (UND 35480, REP 25696, DEM 29451), Sullivan: total 29182 (UND 11855, REP 9514, DEM 7813).
data_quality: high — official NH Secretary of State report; all 243 town/city units retained; every unit's party figures sum to its town total; sum of all units matches the statewide grand total (956,346) exactly; 10-county rollup also reconciles to the statewide total.
notes: Granularity used: town/city (NH's official reporting unit; ~243 units including towns, cities, and unincorporated places). Each unit carries a 'county' field; a fully reconciled 10-county rollup is provided in as_of_notes. county_unit_label set to 'town' because NH SoS publishes data by town/city, not as a standalone county table.
